notes.title: Change of Scheduled Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello.
Sorry!!! We have postponed the scheduled release date of “Yamafuda! Summit” release date has been postponed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832953/68ad9d70a3cf66abdbfc6cf33e4add3f64ef639f.png[/img]
The mountain that we two were challenging was steeper than we expected...!

I am energized daily by your play and feedback. Thank you very much!
We will continue to do my best to hike the mountain!

Have a good holiday season!
